تلتبسون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَبِسُونَ (taltabisūna) /tal.ta.bi.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# تُلْتَبَسُونَ (tultabasūna) /tul.ta.ba.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
